standard_prerequisites: the definition of a formal modification via properness, rig-etale-ness, and rig-surjectivity including diagonals
the three base change lemmas of the same chapter: base-change-proper (Formal Spaces), base-change-rig-etale, and base-change-rig-surjective
the functoriality of the /T completion construction under base change, so that the diagonal of the base change is the base change of the diagonal by an adic morphism
core_obligations: If f : X to Y is a formal modification of locally Noetherian formal algebraic spaces and Y' to Y is adic, then the base change f' : X x_Y Y' to Y' is a formal modification.

The proof checks: f' proper by the Formal Spaces base change lemma; f' rig-etale by base-change-rig-etale; f' rig-surjective by base-change-rig-surjective; and the diagonal Delta_{f'} is the base change of Delta_f by an adic morphism, hence rig-surjective by base-change-rig-surjective again.
proof_roadmap: Verify properness, rig-etale-ness, and rig-surjectivity of f' from the three base change lemmas.
Identify Delta_{f'} as the base change of Delta_f and apply base-change-rig-surjective to the diagonal.
difficulty_reason: H2: a stability proof that runs the formal modification conditions through the three base change lemmas, with the diagonal handled by a second application of rig-surjective base change.
